about: Collect lookups v1. The cognitive platform reaches nothing outside itself: every outside question (domain registry, web archive, fact-check databases) is asked of collect through this one endpoint. One file for both sides: the engine parses the example answers below (tests/unit/test_block_gather.py, tests/unit/test_block_verify.py), next-admin answers in exactly this shape (lib/collect/__tests__/collect-lookups.test.ts). Change both sides and this file in one commit.
decided: 2026-09-17 operator: the cognitive platform has no data collection of its own (WORKLOG 2026-09-17 續14). 2026-10-04 operator, why: each LEGO block is built separately and then chained; collect is the searcher block. So lookups that only describe a source are collect's too.
auth: Authorization: Bearer <COLLECT_RESEARCH_RUNS_TOKEN>, the same token and the same base URL (COGNITIVE_OS_COLLECTION_SERVICE_URL) as /api/internal/collect/runs. No token on either side = 401 / the engine does not call.
cell: {"state", "value"?, "why"?}. 查到 carries a non-empty value. 查不到 and 無法檢查 carry a non-empty why in plain Chinese that says what happened, and no value. No other keys.

answer_item.site: the name a registry holds (example.com, example.com.tw), empty string when the URL has no host
answer_item.registered: cell: YYYY-MM-DD registration date from the registry's RDAP record
answer_item.country: cell: the registrant's country as the record states it, in Chinese when collect's country list has it; most registries hide it, which is 查不到
answer_item.first_archived: cell: YYYY-MM-DD of the Internet Archive's earliest capture

rules: R1 One answer item per request item, same order, url or text echoed.

R2 A lookup that failed (timeout, 5xx, refused, registry not on collect's list, fact-check mirror not downloaded yet) is 無法檢查 with why. The whole request fails only on 401 (token) or 400 (unknown kind, too many items, a URL that is not http(s), text too long).
R3 查不到 only when the outside source answered and said it has nothing: RDAP 404, no archive capture, no fact-check match.

R4 collect keeps nothing from the case. project_id is for its rate limit and log only. The ClaimReview mirror is a public dataset collect refreshes once a day on its own schedule (the hourly collection heartbeat), never per case.

R5 Matching thresholds and lists live in collect only: RDAP registry list and country names, ClaimReview minimum overlap 0.6 (share of the claim's 3-character pieces), Cofacts minimumShouldMatch 50%, at most 5 hits per database. The engine never sends or stores them.
R6 Every outside call in collect goes through collect's own fetcher (lib/collect/net): its address guard, per-host rate limit and timeouts.

R7 The engine, when collect cannot be asked or does not answer (no token, unreachable, 401, 5xx, timeout): every describe cell is 無法檢查 「蒐集器這次沒有回應」, every fact-check db is 無法檢查 with the same why, and the run's later describe batches are not asked. An answer that came back but is not in this shape (not JSON, too large, wrong kind or item count) is 無法檢查 「蒐集器的回答格式不對」 for that request only. It never raises out of a hook and never retries inside the same run.
R8 The engine checks every cell with evidence_words.cell(); a malformed cell becomes 無法檢查 「蒐集器的回答格式不對」. It asks once per site per hook run.

R9 The engine's egress allowlist keeps only the AI provider and the collect service. RDAP hosts, archive.org, storage.googleapis.com and api.cofacts.tw leave docker-compose.yml and policies/ai-execution/network-egress.yaml; the engine has no platform/net/rdap.py, wayback.py, claimreview.py or cofacts.py.
